newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Air, United Airline launch flight deal.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Air, United Airline launch flight deal.

text.p: Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp launched its first flight to New York under a marketing agreement reached with UAL's Corp's United Airlines, the official Saudi news agency said on Tuesday.
The agreement, signed on January 27, launched a "marketing cooperation programme between the two carriers covering the Jeddah/New York/Los Angeles route". It took effect on February 18.
Passengers of Saudi Arabian's twice-weekly, Jeddah-New York flights would now be able to check through to Los Angeles.
Passengers leaving Los Angeles for Jeddah would similarly be issued with boarding passes checking them through New York and on to Jeddah.
Saudi officials said similar agreements could be clinched with United Airlines in the future to cover other destinations.
